name: Anime Battle UI Renderer
description: Message renderer with character avatar system, battle state indicators, scene transitions, speaker detection from AI text, and interactive technique/choice selection. Demonstrates: asset manifest pattern, speaker alias resolution, scene detection markers, stat HUD with multiple indicators, XML tag parsing for choices.

requires.notes: Number variables for HP, level, energy. String for battle-state (normal/combat/domain). String for current scene character. JSON array for relationships.

author: yumina-official
